thread:
anya: Heads-up: invoice preview is showing duplicate token lines when alias->fallback happens. Spotted in canary.

devon: Confirmed on staging. Proxy gives new req_id for fallback, metering keys on req_id so we get two events.

maria: Quick mitigation: have edge emit canonical_req_id + canonical_model before fallback. Downstream can dedupe on canonical_req_id.

liam: Schema change is invasive. Need consumer opt-in flag and migration notes. Event size increases matter at scale.

ops-eng: Low-risk path: aggregator coalescer using fingerprint (tenant + session + prompt_prefix) within 1s window to merge duplicates. No producer schema changes.

anya: Which do we do for the canary?

devon: Hybrid: enable coalescer behind flag for 2% canary, sample canonical fields at edge (2%) to validate correctness. If metrics look good, roll schema and flip consumers gradually.

maria: I'll open the schema PR with sampling toggle.

liam: I'll add consumer config `accepts_canonical_id` default false so joins don’t break.

ops-eng: Telemetry: add billing.preview_dup_rate, billing.preview_delta_tokens, billing.dedupe_events_per_min. Alert if preview_dup_rate > 0.2% for 15m.

billing-bot: BILL-914 created to track migration, reconciliation and email suppression for canary cohorts.

anya: Console UX: mark previews as "Provisional (may include duplicates during rollouts)" and pause preview emails for canary tenants.

devon: Canary plan: 2% for 30m -> check metrics -> 25% -> 100%. Will report back.
